title: Drop Engram grant delivery-page and delivery_tokens handling once Engram w-106de4b03b57 is installed
outcome: Turn-gate simplification (Engram::Opus relay, mailbox #200 to #203). Grants will carry no delivery page, and turn_begin will not need delivery_tokens. Compatibility is confirmed both ways: today's TermAl accepts a page-less grant (EngramIssuedTurnGrant.delivery is an Option with serde default, so turn_begin sends delivery_tokens: []), and w-106de4b03b57's acceptance requires Engram to accept an empty or absent delivery_tokens. So Engram installs first and this cleanup is not a blocker. Scope: remove the page parsing, EngramDeliveredRange, the delivery_tokens in TurnBegin and its begin-intent key, and the related fixtures (src/tests/engram_control_transport.rs, engram_host_adapter.rs, fixtures/engram-control-fixture.ps1). Wait for Engram::Opus's exact wire diff before starting. See also tm-e5lj (nudge costs a delivery page).
